text: Long running agents forget why they ran old experiments. Second Shift keeps the whole research campaign in MongoDB Atlas, and rebuilds every decision from that evidence.
The workload is real brain signal data. Claude picks the next experiment from a fixed menu and cites its evidence. Code computes every number.
Now we kill the worker in the middle of a job. A new process rebuilds the campaign from Atlas, reuses the finished work, and reruns the orphaned job as attempt two.
We wipe the context and cut the electrode budget from sixty four to nine. It reranks what it already measured, and keeps searching under the new goal.
Each decision sees a small evidence packet. Jev routes the model's notes into memory, and Vector Search brings them back.
Measured today: eight of eight recovery checks, five of five constraint checks, and ten thousand memory notes with context held near twelve hundred tokens.
One persistent mission. Bounded context. Measured results.
